span.p:
is this the empty
struct VSZ2lqvlggVb ?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
recurse: check(child) must hold for every child.
value(child) = child.prime, or 2 for the empty node.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
child values non-decreasing,
AND their product == prime - 1 ?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Lucas test, func 3268, with the node's witness w

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
w^(prime-1) mod prime == 1, and for every
child value q, w^((prime-1)/q) mod prime != 1 ?
So w must be a primitive root,
not merely a Fermat witness.
